acquisition_policy.replay: Wayback nearest available historical capture; final redirected timestamp is authoritative
acquisition_policy.failure_policy: Retain failed attempts, no silent substitution of current site.

sample_plan.rule: Once all23indices are available:8entries at zero-based ranks floor(j*(N-1)/7),j=0..7, in first-occurrence index order. Then record exact page markers/length/table status; no favorable reselection. If indices incomplete, do not pretend sample is whole-inventory sample.

readiness: Inventory complete only when all23indices verified; entry links do not establish archivedbody coverage.
